lastReleaseMessage: The three stylesheets carry the build query the modules carry, the module-route note says the graph is whole, and the five hollow symbols record the solid file each was cut from

barRaise.topFinding: Four lenses landed on one file this run and the file is src/state.js. defaultState() hand-copies a herb record data/herbs.json owns, and the copy never moved when the data did: src/state.js:167-168 still carries the GABA-A receptor and warfarin phrasing v1.2.0 spent a release removing. The same file's colour defaults never reach the contrast gate the project runs over herbs.json, so shopColor #E8C172 at :192 renders the shop name at 1.17 to 1 on the default parchment, which is invisible, and accent #A77C24 at :153 measures 2.59 against a 4.5 bar. Three more defects sit beside it: typing one character into a section title destroys the input that has focus (src/ui/title-editor.js:24-45 with src/state.js:31-34), flushPrintStage() is exported at src/render.js:682 and called from nowhere although the queue row asking for it is marked completed, and the dev-log dedupe file still reads v1.1.14 twenty days after v1.2.0 shipped. The application works and the release pipeline is sound; what is broken is the one data source no gate reads.

Give the layout designer chips a keyboard and click path that moves the real instance, including out of the hidden rail.
Call the version-pill check with no flags inside the dashboard status writer, warning on drift.
Gate the illustration grid HTML on gridOpen and have the four other subscribers diff their own state slice.
Run the duplicate-key scanner over data/aliases.json and both maps in data/herb-to-illustration.json.
Rewrite the six cited herb records to folklore framing and widen the clinical pattern list to the spelled-out terms.
Add a row for each gate and utility script to the file-layout table.
Delete outputs/new_herbs_batch2.json and its sources file, and drop the ignore carve-out.
Add a cache-busting query string to the live check and assert the body carries the new build stamp.
Derive the default accent from the default herb's record, or add the src/state.js literals to the contrast test.
Add the shrink declaration to the print block and extend the parity test to PRINT_STAGE_RULES.
Delete the duplicate file-layout row and move the stranded row into its own block.
Credit the two attribution-licensed symbols, or swap them for the public-domain alternates.
Compare source and destination after the index.html copy and abort the mirror on a mismatch.

test-data-integrity.mjs gained section 12b: every theme in use has its shopColor, latinColor and descColor checked against its own paperGradEnd at the same 4.5:1 bar the herb accent already met. Those three come from the theme rather than the herb, so one bad value is wrong on every label at once, which is worse than one herb reading poorly. Proved by making one bad on purpose: a lightened latinColor failed at 1.14:1 and the suite exited 1, and the file was restored and the suite passes.

src/main.js reads var(--warn) for the boot-failure screen instead of the #C4580A literal, which is exactly what --warn holds in styles/base.css. Two copies of one colour drift the day the token moves, and this is the screen nobody looks at until it matters.

The file-layout table in CLAUDE.md carries a row for every source file again. Five were missing, not the four the finding named: escape-html.js, resolve-illustration.js, saved-labels.js, suggest.js and truncate.js. Each description is read off the header the file already carried about itself rather than guessed, and a walk over src/ now finds no .js file without a row. Committed from the index rather than the working tree, so the uncommitted convention edit another session left in that file stayed theirs.

Every herb record drops the clinical register, 37 rewrites across four fields, and a gate in test-data-integrity.mjs refuses the twenty words the file actually carried. A source could not be added honestly: the text was written as flavour copy for a label designer rather than from a reference, and inventing a citation would be worse than the sentence it dressed up. So the finding's other half is the one taken, and what a plant is said to do stays while the drug class, the receptor and the mechanism go. Another session had started the same work on the compounds field and stopped, which is why its edits were sitting uncommitted; this finished the sweep across cautions, historicUses, desc and descFull as well. A scan for the register returns zero, and all five suites pass.
